text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a fantastic performance in the
Twinkle
Series, Grass Wonder has had an
impressive first
three years.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A large milestone is now behind us. But
one
peaceful day...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well then, everyone...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now that things have settled down,
would all of
you like to join me on a hike
in the mountains?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Say what?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: As in mountain mountains?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I thought it might be nice for us all to
have a trip
together before El goes
overseas.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, this is new, Grass being all

spur-of-the-moment.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It sounds like it'll be a lotta fun!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And you're doin' it all for me? I'm so so
so so
touched! So grateful! So—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It's just a little idea for everyone to make some lovely memories, that's all.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ouch! Reeejected!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But of course. Your presence is an
absolute must,
Trainer.
choice_data_list: 俺まで一緒でよかったのか？
私まで一緒でよかったの？
choice_data_list_en: Was it really okay for me to come along too?
Are you sure it was okay for me to come along too?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I can hardly wait. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we head for the base of
the
mountain?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's been ages since I saw Grass
smile like
this.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... It irks me knowin' it's cuz she's
been winnin'
like mad!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Though... it's true that a sunny sonrisa is
what
suits Grass best.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But that said, I am SO wipin' that smirk
off her
face eventually!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, will you, El?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
C... c'mon everybody! We're gonna lose
all the
daylight draggin' our feet like
this! Let's run to
the mountain!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sounds like a race. I'm in.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Last one there's gotta carry all our bags!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The stakes have skyrocketed! That's a
little scary,
Sei!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Get back hereeee!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wha—?! E-everybody?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hmph! All right then!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I won't lose, do you hear me?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my... Everyone is just so competitive.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? Your thoughts are written all
over your
face.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Dear me... Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Not today, no.
choice_data_list_en: Aren't you going to chase after them?
Aren't you going to chase after them?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Today... I want to savor each step along
the way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder and I leisurely take in the
sights
along the green trail upward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Each foot we lay upon the earth brings
us another
step forward.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There is no path before me, only in my
wake.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The first time I stepped onto the
racetrack, I
knew it was where I should
be.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I decided that if I were to press forward,
I could
not allow myself to stop until I
reached the very
top.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
At first, I believed it would be
straightforward.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes... You're exactly right.
choice_data_list: 実際は、曲がりくねってた？

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I was stumbling through my immaturity,
caught up
by trivialities. I even got told
off by my own
friend.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: With how slow my progress felt, there were some nights I wondered whether I even could reach the top.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But not any longer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have Maruzen and Sei. Suzuka, El, and
Spe,
too...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm surrounded by so many friends and

supporters... And most of all, Trainer, I
have you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
This is the path I was meant to tread,
because I'm
the only one who can.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A path extending far into the distance,
to a
destination only I can reach.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So... I will keep my head held high and
take each
step with purpose.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: To reach the top!
